description: Pipedrive connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's Pipedrive CRM deals as `pipedrive:deal` items in the local index — the deal title, value + currency, status (open/won/lost), stage and pipeline ids, the linked person/organization names, the owner, probability, label, expected close date, and won/close times. Useful for answering sales questions ("what deals are closing this month?", "find the Acme renewal deal") without leaving Nimbus. Auth is via the API token IN THE QUERY STRING (`?api_token=<token>`) — there is NO Authorization header, so the request URL itself carries the secret and is never logged or surfaced in errors. The SaaS host (api.pipedrive.com) is fixed. Pipedrive paginates `/v1/deals` by `start`/`next_start` offsets (page_size=100), returning the `{ success, data, additional_data: { pagination: { more_items_in_collection, next_start } } }` envelope; `data` may be null. Pipedrive's `add_time` / `update_time` are non-ISO `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"` UTC strings (converted to epoch-ms on index). Persons / organizations / activities / notes are deferred follow-ups; v1 indexes deals only.
author: Nimbus
